targetEra.scene: ordinary midsummer Japanese new-town apartment exterior

historicalBasis.claim: A rooftop fishbone/Yagi receiving silhouette is appropriate evidence for the year-2000 target because Japanese terrestrial television remained analogue until the 2011 switchover; VHF receiving arrays were part of the analogue-era installation vocabulary.

Analogue-era Japanese rooftop reception commonly used Yagi-style antennas, with VHF used for major analogue terrestrial channels and UHF also used for regional channels; this pass therefore models separate large-VHF and compact-UHF arrays rather than a modern flat design antenna.

assembly.reasoning: Use one maintained communal rooftop service assembly as a period marker. Do not randomize manufactured apartment modules or scatter nostalgic props. The assembly must have a legible load path, cable path and frequency-dependent antenna proportions.

location.edgeSetbackIntent: kept inward from the parapet so the mounting reads as maintained communal infrastructure

components.name: non_penetrating_ballast_base
components.mounting: gravity ballast supporting paired galvanized base rails; no unexplained roof membrane penetration
components.interfaces: block-to-roof bearing surface, block-to-rail compression/contact, mast saddle at crossed rail center
components.geometryVsMaterial: block mass, rail thickness, saddle and gaps are geometry; aggregate/pinhole response belongs to material microdetail

components.name: galvanized_mast
components.manufacture: round steel tube, hot-dip galvanized after fabrication
components.mounting: clamped into galvanized saddle above paired base rails
components.interfaces: mast-saddle clamp, boom-to-mast clamps, coax tied alongside mast

components.name: vhf_yagi_array
components.manufacture: tubular boom and transverse conductive elements with dielectric feed enclosure
components.mounting: boom clamped to mast around 2.93 m above roof
components.orientation: elements transverse to boom; physically larger than UHF array

components.name: uhf_yagi_array
components.manufacture: compact tubular boom and transverse conductive elements with dielectric feed enclosure
components.mounting: boom clamped to mast around 2.34 m above roof
components.orientation: elements transverse to boom; visibly more compact than VHF array

components.name: coax_and_roof_junction
components.mounting: coax follows mast downward, then turns into a short roof conduit and weather-resistant junction box
components.interfaces: feed-box cable exit, mast clips implied by cable adjacency, roof conduit, enclosure entry
components.geometryVsMaterial: cable route and enclosure depth are geometry; UV chalking and fine molding texture belong to material

materials.albedoLinearIntent: neutral slightly cool zinc-grey, no painted highlight
materials.specularF0: conductor response; do not force dielectric F0
materials.microstructure: subtle zinc-spangle/rolled-tube irregularity; must not become a visible tiled camouflage pattern
materials.wetness: benchmark is dry; rain-wet state would primarily lower roughness rather than darken via painted gloss
materials.uvAging: mild oxidation dulling only; no orange ferrous rust on intact zinc surface
materials.angularFresnelResponse: real metallic edge/grazing response from the shader/environment; no baked white stripe

materials.albedoLinearIntent: dark charcoal rather than absolute black
materials.microstructure: fine injection-molded plastic texture below silhouette scale
materials.uvAging: slight chalking/desaturation on upward/sunward faces only
materials.angularFresnelResponse: weak dielectric grazing lift, never mirror-like

materials.albedoLinearIntent: very dark neutral PVC with enough value to retain cylindrical form
materials.uvAging: subtle upper-surface fading, no random white speckles

materials.albedoLinearIntent: weathered neutral warm-grey; no AO or contact shadow painted into albedo
materials.microstructure: fine aggregate, pores and form/mold variation at millimetric scale
materials.wetness: dry benchmark; no global wet gloss

lodPolicy.lod0: 8 VHF elements + 14 UHF elements + feed boxes + coax path + four ballast blocks
lodPolicy.lod1: 6 VHF + 8 UHF elements while retaining feed/cable/base read
lodPolicy.lod2: 4 VHF + 4 UHF elements; preserve two-frequency silhouette and load path
lodPolicy.lod3: 2 VHF + 2 UHF elements plus mast/booms/base; silhouette only
lodPolicy.antiPopRequirement: actual 4K motion evidence is required; source-side cross-fade is readiness only

lookdevBrief.frontal: At native 4K the roofline should gain a restrained late-analogue-era infrastructure silhouette. Large VHF and smaller UHF arrays must read as two engineered scales, not one decorative comb. Mast base should sit on the roof without floating.
lookdevBrief.oblique: Boom depth, element spacing, mast clamps/base rails and cable path should demonstrate real assembly depth. No element should visibly interpenetrate the mast or another array.
lookdevBrief.grazingLight: Galvanized members should develop narrow moving metallic highlights from sky/sun reflection while remaining rough; black feed boxes/coax stay dielectric. Concrete ballast remains broad and matte. No highlight may be painted into albedo.
100PercentCropChecks: LOD transition or shimmer if motion evidence becomes available

visualGateMapping.periodAccuracySceneAuthenticity: primary expected benefit; year-2000 roofline receives a historically coherent analogue receiving system rather than generic modern flat antennas
visualGateMapping.geometryConstructionFidelity: visible load path from roof ballast to rails/saddle/mast/booms/elements and explicit cable route
visualGateMapping.materialPBR: bare galvanized zinc is metallic; feed enclosure/PVC/concrete are dielectric
visualGateMapping.temporalLod: four explicit cross-faded LOD levels; runtime evidence still mandatory

automaticFailIfObserved: modern flat/design terrestrial antenna replacing the year-2000 analogue Yagi silhouette without documented context
Unity primitive placeholder mesh visible in benchmark framing
galvanized metal treated as painted dielectric or ABS/PVC/concrete treated as metal
painted or baked white antenna highlights
floating mast base or unexplained roof penetration

renderVerification.instruction: Do not award Period Accuracy, Geometry, Material or Temporal points from source configuration alone.
